name: analyze
description: This skill should be used when the user wants to analyze AI workflow opportunities, run a workflow audit, find automation candidates, or says "where can AI help". With the user's permission, looks through their saved memory and past chats for opportunities, walks their processes, then registers every candidate as a backlog Workflow node in the AI Registry (work that already runs as in production), or lists it with the report where there is no registry, ready for the Deconstruct step. Also use when the user says "continue my workflow" and Analyze's progress file (analyze-in-progress.md) exists. It stays strategic: it names the work, the pain, and the value, never the tools or integrations. This is the Analyze step of the AI Workflow Framework.
